request: Latest user instruction supersedes ACK1/50 Mbps: keep ACK2 at low receive rate; permit larger ACK thresholds from 100 Mbps.

policy.scope: Per QUIC connection, application-data packet number space, both receive directions
policy.receive_rate_bytes: Accepted ack-eliciting QUIC packet wire length, including QUIC headers/authentication, excluding IP/UDP headers
policy.at_or_above_threshold: Allow existing PMTU-settled, quiet-packet progression; ceiling remains Mihomo 6 and Xray 8

estimator.idle_expiration: on next received packet; no periodic timer

policy.pending_tail: Retain existing maximum ACK delay and BBR RTT budget; do not postpone the first pending packet's deadline
policy.idle_without_pending_ack: No unsolicited ACK or extra ACK timer
policy.exceptional_packets: Gaps, previously missing packets and ECN-CE immediately queue ACK and reset learned cadence to 2, including already queued ACK / packet-count boundary
policy.ignored_for_rate: ACK-only, rejected duplicate/old packets, and internal calls without a packet size
